import { attachControl } from "@babylonjs/lite";

export function attachFastOrbit(camera: ArcRotateCamera, canvas: HTMLCanvasElement, scene: SceneContext): () => void {

  if (Number.isFinite(originalAngularSensibility) && originalAngularSensibility !== 0) {
    camera.angularSensibility = originalAngularSensibility / 2;

  const disposeControl = attachControl(camera, canvas, scene);
  return () => {
    disposeControl();
    if (Number.isFinite(originalAngularSensibility) && originalAngularSensibility !== 0) {
      camera.angularSensibility = originalAngularSensibility;
    }
  };
}
